Tamil Nadu Govt's Supreme Court Plea for Deepam Festival Fails

The Tamil Nadu government's attempt to get an urgent hearing in the Supreme Court regarding the 'Deepam' festival was unsuccessful. The government's Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department had filed a review petition seeking immediate listing. However, the judge assigned to the case did not sit on Monday, leading to the government's plea being deferred. The matter is now expected to be heard on Wednesday, potentially clearing the path for the 'Karthigai Deepam' festival. One report suggests the government's stance is based on a report calling a pillar related to the festival a British-era survey marker, which may impact the lamp lighting.
